posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
With many thanks to Danny and all those who commented on the site, here's the new one:

[http://www.triple-take.com/](http://www.triple-take.com/)

We've cut down on the number of buttons and no button leads to nowhere. We hope, it's easy to navigate.

We wanted to firstly create something simple and easy so we took elements out of Danny's work and created this "dumbed down" site. We hope in the future to incorporate some of Danny's ideas as we improve functionality.

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Excellent. I like the first page as it states right to the point what your site is about. Although it states one can buy on line, I do not see the prices or a method of buying. Also, I don't see your fresh DCG plates offered.

Peace!

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md: You're right, we don't have a way of buying online. It's one of the things that need fixing along with the DCG plates. We're going to be working with Danny to get the "online store" part started next week. One problem was that the site contained elements such as Flash that not all browsers have. I'm thinking that maybe there'll be two entrances, one for them that has all the bells and whistles and another for them that don't. Apparently there's a way to let the browser figure that out and route users appropriately. Still trying to read up on that.

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
Seems completely functional with Mozilla 1.75, and is indeed easy to navigate. I assume that the lack of pricing info and shopping cart is only temporary. Some suggestions:

Many shoppers will be unfamiliar with the term DCG, but just spelling it out will not help. Perhaps call them "super-bright (DCG) holograms", with the DCG keyword linked to a (non-technical) page explaining the merits of DCG over other inferior technologies.

An animated gif or two showing the full parallax effect of a real hologram would be helpful.

Possible selling points:

"Real holograms - beware of imitations!"

"Lovingly hand-made right here in the good ole USA by highly trained physicists using lasers, mirrors, lenses and other high-tech gadgets!"

"Not available in stores! - Factory-direct pricing - bypass the middleman"

"If you really care what time it is, we also offer our clocks with hour markings subtly etched into the glass"

"Buy 1000, get 1 Absolutely Free!"

"No animals were harmed in the making of these holograms, except maybe for the gelatin donors, but let's not get into that"

"Caution - may induce hallucinations. Do not use holograms while operating heavy machinery"

"Exaggerated claims for hologram viewing as leading to enhanced sexual activity and bone-shaking orgasms have appeared in the popular press. We do not promote the use of holograms for this purpose, and in fact think the idea is ludicrous, but the more credulous among you may wish to take advantage of our special Valentine's day offer (coming soon)"
